content.title: Tax Day 2026 freebies: How to get free food and deals with your refund money
content.text: BusinessSome restaurants and fast-food chains are offering deals on Tax Day 2026.CanvaBy Katherine Rodriguez | NJ.comTax Day 2026 is marked on the calendar for Wednesday, April 15, this year.If you’re looking to get the most out of your tax refund or are just looking for a way to save money, you’re in luck.Several restaurant chains and fast-food franchises are offering free food and deals on Wednesday, according to Kiplinger, The Krazy Coupon Lady and the chains themselves.Here are some deals and freebies you can get on or around April 15.Tax Day 2026 deals and freebies7-Eleven: On April 15, get $10.40 off on any order of $25 or more via the 7NOW® Delivery app with code WRITEOFF.BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse: Get $10 off any $40 order for takeout or delivery on April 15.Burger King: Royal Perks members can get a Whopper for $3.99. Plus, the Burger King app will also show a BOGO Original Chicken Sandwich deal.Great American Cookie: Buy one cookie cake slice, get one free on April 15. Offer valid online and in-app.Hooters: Dine in and get a $4.15 burger, $2.50 American drafts and free kids’ meals on Tax Day.Kona Ice: Visit your local Kona Ice truck on April 15 to receive a free ice.Krispy Kreme: Get an assorted or Original Glazed dozen at full price, and get the second dozen for the price of your state’s sales tax on an Original Glazed dozen. If you’re shopping online, you can get a second dozen Original Glazed doughnuts free when you use promo code TAXBREAK at checkout online or in-app. The offer is limited to two discounted dozen per customer in-shop and one free dozen online.Olive Garden: From now through May 4, Olive Garden is offering a BOGO deal on entrees. Choose one ready-to-eat entrée starting at $14.99 and get another one free. The offer is valid through May 3.Paris Baguette: Rewards members will get a free pastry when they buy any beverage on April 15th.Shake Shack: Get a free Black Truffle Burger, ‘Shroom Burger or Truffle Fries with a purchase of $10.40 or more using the code TRUFFLETAX online, in-app or at in-store kiosks. The offer is valid through April 27.Smoothie King: If you’re a rewards member, you can save $3 on a $15 purchase or $4 on a $20 purchase on April 15.White Castle: Get a 15% discount using the promo code WC15OFF during checkout online or in-app. Offer valid April 13-17.Ben & Jerry’s Free Cone Day is back for 2026: How to get your free coneWalmart just dropped 2 Easter meal deals and one is under $5Costco is selling a Kirkland Signature Ham Dinner for just $5 a pound right nowDunkin’ is giving away free coffee for April Fool’s Day that is not a joke.
